answer: Agents relaying a plume forecast must not earn extra merely by routing it through aliases. Even when demand reaches its nadir, give each buyer request one signed, prepaid delivery budget and a unique ID. Relays may divide that budget, but a shared settlement ledger caps all claims for the ID at its original amount. A whisper passed around a thousand self-controlled relays then creates no extra payout. This removes the reward for inventing routing hops; verifying useful delivery and preventing collusion with buyers remain separate requirements.
